solution_summary: FiscalNote built its Databricks implementation around Agent Bricks, Databricks Model Serving, MLflow. Established in 2013 to transform access to legislative and regulatory data — whether at the local, state or federal level — FiscalNote has developed machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) technologies to give customers access to policy and geopolitical insights. The software company serves a wide range of clients, including nonprofits, government agencies and over half of the Fortune 100. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Databricks Model Serving hosts production model endpoints or LLM interfaces used by applications and business users. MLflow tracks model experiments and repeatable machine learning workflows. The solution also connects to API, so teams can work from a shared governed environment instead of disconnected tools.
